message.content:
The user now needs to confirm the entered phone number and enter the chat interface. There is a checkmark button (ImageView) at the top right corner of the interface, corresponding to the element [882, 123, 999, 175]. Clicking this checkmark will confirm the number and proceed to the next step. Therefore, execute the Tap action to click this checkmark element.


do(action="Tap", element=[940,149])
